description: Confrontation with the cult's core figure Dr. Golan, three gunshots killed the target, livestock howling continues, the battle ends but the mystery remains unsolved

conversation.speaker: player10
conversation.text: SealDice Maid Kito reporting! Now at your service—please give your orders! 1.5.1+20251010

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: @player11 .bot off

conversation.speaker: player11
conversation.text: Sorry, due to special reasons, the dice cannot operate normally. Shutting down... Oops, I messed up the lines, let me go back and rehearse them again, is that okay?

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Silently walks ahead, preparing to go to the 2nd floor.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The investigators go up the stairs and push open the door on the second floor. They see a room like an office with bookshelves and a desk. The desktop is cluttered with stationery and papers, but right in the center lies a fine leather-bound notebook, with a fountain pen resting horizontally on top of it.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Immediately speaks up to remind companions

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: You safely reach the notebook without triggering any mechanisms. Clearly, this is just an ordinary room. The only hazard is the books scattered all over the floor; you could easily trip if you're not careful.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #At this point, prepares to read this notebook.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: You open the notebook. It is signed by Golan Berenzada.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "So it is that doctor's notebook after all..."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: To extract important information from it, please make a Library Use roll.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: .ra Library Use

conversation.speaker: player10
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire. If it is what you wish for, it will surely be answered. <player4>'s Library Use prayer:

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Carefully pays attention to the surroundings.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The notebook was written after Golan arrived in this city. At first, it describes how Golan shook off the shadows of war, found a job and established himself, even having the capacity to help disabled soldiers in this city. The Golan of this time was a simple and kind person.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: #Asks player9 to observe if there are any places where someone could hide in the night.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: December 30

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Then there's indeed no need to be polite."

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "This person is no longer human. Must be shot."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Hmm, truly arrogant, even writing down his own sins in the diary."

conversation.speaker: player9
conversation.text: "Who needs to be taken out?"

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "Dr. Golan."

conversation.speaker: player9
conversation.text: #Didn't read the diary but has been on alert and heard the keywords.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Let's go. There shouldn't be anything else here. Be careful and go check other places. Let's take out that doctor."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Modifying the human body..."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "He has already violated the doctor's code."

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: #Fingers tremble slightly, bringing a cigarette to his lips. Thinks for a moment and puts it down again.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Closes the notebook, puts it away, then prepares to check the books on the floor, also taking a look at the papers on the desk.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: (Make a Spot Hidden roll.)

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: .ra Spot Hidden

conversation.speaker: player10
conversation.text: Jaw Crusher (Model PE-600×900)

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: Hydraulic Roll Crusher (2PG-1200×1000)

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Bridge Double-Girder Crane (Q=16/3.2t)

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Four-Column Hydraulic Press (YL32-200T)

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: Belt Conveyor (B=800mm)

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Clinker Rotary Kiln (Φ3.2×52m)

conversation.speaker: player10
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you expect, it will be answered. <player3>'s Investigation prayer:

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The office is too cluttered for you to immediately find useful information, but you can tell that most of these materials are leftover reports and data from the original factory.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: .ra Investigation

conversation.speaker: player10
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you expect, it will be answered. <player8>'s Investigation prayer:

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: You find a document as above.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: #Show it to a few team members.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: And the map on the back, which is your reason for taking this document.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "Things in the factory that can still operate." #Nodding.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "How about we go to the maintenance workshop next?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The distant cries and hoofbeats of livestock surge gradually, pounding the silent air like an approaching tide.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Silently drawing the pistol, calmer than before.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Every moment of hesitation now fuels the growth of darkness. Decide when it's time to decide, act when it's time to act.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #No longer hesitating, choosing to step into the darkness personally.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The investigators follow the map to the empty maintenance workshop, seeing only the four-column hydraulic press standing in the center. The gray cast-iron frame bears two hundred tons of pressure. The one-square-meter worktable is stained with solidified oil, the slide suspended above at a maximum opening of eighty centimeters.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "Do you think this thing can crush those blasphemous scum?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Carbon-based lifeforms definitely can't fight machinery."

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: #Hold Bailan back.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Huh? ... Hmm, what's wrong?"

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "Then do you think a flesh-and-blood body can win against a bunch?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Hmm, we can make use of that machine over there."

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "Hurry, hurry!" #Dragging player9 and a few others, running wildly.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: (Where did they go?)

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: .stshow Stealth

conversation.speaker: player10
conversation.text: <player8>'s currently registered personal information is as follows:

conversation.speaker: player9
conversation.text: "Leave this dangerous job to me."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Be careful."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Alright, you go first and stay safe. Check out the situation and come back to inform us."

conversation.speaker: player9
conversation.text: #Take a deep breath and try to hide.

conversation.speaker: player10
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you wish for, it will be answered. <player9>'s Stealth prayer:

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The investigators step out of the maintenance workshop and head east, passing the silent rotary kiln. The cries of livestock come from further east. All clues point to the main workshop at the end of the road.

conversation.speaker: player9
conversation.text: #Follow the clues and move towards the main workshop.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: player9 silently approaches the main workshop door. Through the crack, he catches a glimpse of Dr. Golan's back facing the entrance. The workshop is unlit, darkness only allowing faint outlines of large machinery to be seen.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: (Or just look through the crack.)

conversation.speaker: player9
conversation.text: #First try to peek through the door crack.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Dr. Golan is looking down at the dagger in his hand, his lips slightly parting as he mutters indistinctly.

conversation.speaker: player9
conversation.text: #Screw it, kick the door open.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: The iron door lets out a tearing roar upon impact. Dr. Golan turns abruptly, the dagger in his hand slicing through the air with a cold glint. Behind his glasses, his pupils dilate slightly in shock.

conversation.speaker: player9
conversation.text: .ra Handgun

conversation.speaker: player10
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you wish for, it will be answered. <player9>'s Handgun prayer:

conversation.speaker: player9
conversation.text: .ra Handgun

conversation.speaker: player10
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you wish for, it will be answered. <player9>'s Handgun prayer:

conversation.speaker: player9
conversation.text: .ra Handgun

conversation.speaker: player10
conversation.text: Belief arises from desire; if it is what you wish for, it will be answered. <player9>'s Handgun prayer:

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: (Hmm, roll it.)

conversation.speaker: player10
conversation.text: Alright, alright, I'm rolling...
